doc.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995

title: Why singers sound best with the Basie band
summary: Fillius says great vocalists sing better with Basie; Jillean says none matched Joe, and the band has a unique spark.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I find, I believe from the records that I have and have played that every singer I know of sings better with the Basie band than anybody else. Sinatra for one. Tony Bennett, Sarah Vaughan. There’s a whole collection. All the great vocalists recorded with Basie at one time or another. And you put them all together and they’re just fabulous. Have you ever listened to them?
But nobody holds a candle to Joe Williams and the Basie band.
All these people, all these wonderful names, these wonderful professionals who are big, big stars, have never come up to Joe in the Basie band. Don’t you agree with that?
No, you’re absolutely right. But understand what I’m saying. I’m saying they sing better—
With the band than they do with Nelson or anybody. They have a different timbre in their voices. They just, you know that rhythm is incredible.
Yes. Well there’s a spark in the Basie band that the others don’t have.
